title: Harvest of Thrones
last_recap: The farmer stood before the broken king, facing a hostile court. His amulet flared, stunning the guards and the king. The crowd realized his royal ancestry as the king surrendered the iron crown. The farmer rejected the throne, throwing it into the fire and walking away into the storm.
ending_cliffhanger: Will he return to the farm, or is the empire still hunting him?
character: a 45-year-old farmer man, weathered olive-tan skin, kind deep-set brown eyes, short black hair with gray at the temples, thick eyebrows, a small scar over his left eyebrow, wearing a patched beige linen tunic and a worn copper amulet on a leather cord, mud-flecked leather boots
